verdict.rationale: Bento has a dedicated transactional-email doc explicitly covering receipts, password resets, login codes, and order confirmations, and this sits alongside the same platform's broadcast/automation/marketing APIs and SDKs (JS, Ruby, PHP, Laravel, etc.) using shared HTTP Basic auth conventions. Missing for 10: no explicit code sample showing a transactional send API call/endpoint, and no independent/hands-on confirmation of deliverability or API behavior for transactional sends.
